topics.purpose: Define the CV-replacement projection as a continuously updated verified competence history based on Projects, portfolio evidence, merits, Tier, recommendations, trust and linked outcomes.

semantics.verified_rule: Verified evidence and self-authored narrative are clearly separated.
semantics.time_rule: Temporal distribution remains visible rather than collapsing all evidence into one undated claim.
semantics.project_rule: Project evidence remains linked to exact Projects where public.
semantics.update_rule: Projection updates from accepted underlying evidence rather than manual overwrite.
semantics.authority_rule: Living CV is presentation/evidence projection, not employment/authorization authority.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

hard_gates.condition: all merits collapsed without time provenance

references.purpose: Living CV is one competence profile projection.
